title: The language workspace names its participant and mandate
summary: records/language.ia declares `@agent language-participant` (governance.applies is empty) and `@mandate language-mandate` (authority: participant language-participant; moves Observation, Verification and Synthesis; scope language-workspace; covers .ia/src). language-workspace names the participant as its composition.steward. The bundled inventarch/language base that `ia init` installs carries both records, so consumer workspaces receive them. The mandate grants no host permission. No word or schema changes; the vocabulary catalogues carry a new source digest.
